headline: Recommended $1,250,000 transfer, $689,545 appropriation, and $50,000 police repairs to joint council meeting.
summary: Members approved two bid waivers, a contract award, and a new golf course fund. They recommended several budget transfers to a joint meeting with the city council. Special education spending is over budget, and members discussed how to limit it.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, items 3a through k.
Recommended a $50,000 transfer from the general fund contingency account to police repairs and maintenance.
Recommended a $49,745 transfer within the equipment building system fund.
Approved a bid waiver to Marcus Communications for security cameras at three city parking garages.
Approved a motion to award contract 2, E-67-007.
Recommended a $40,000 transfer from the general fund contingency account for professional fees.
Approved a bid waiver to Culpepper for the pension consultant request for proposals.
Recommended a $689,545 additional appropriation within the general fund as of June 30th, 2026.
Recommended a $1,250,000 transfer from the general fund contingency account.
Recommended a $101,021 additional appropriation and a $7,995 transfer within the road improvements fund.
Approved creating fund 410, Chippany Municipal Golf course fund.
discussion: Special education overspending: Members said private out-of-district tuition is about 1.4 million over budget and asked whether other budget lines could offset it.
Special education enrollment: Members asked how Bristol's share of new special education students compares with other towns, and whether other districts see the same trend.
Encumbrance practice: Members discussed whether encumbering funds early gives a clearer picture, since invoices often arrive late.
Cafeteria fund: Staff reported a surplus of 721,972, but members questioned whether the fund would break even this year.

Edgewood school project: A liaison update said a $6.7 million increase was approved on September 22, 2026, and the city council approved the construction manager's price on October 13, 2026. Members asked for the expected completion date.
